title: Introduce frugal-fusion prefetch optimizer and telemetry bridge
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: tenant workloads show correlated cold-start patterns that the current prefetch heuristics miss, and static quant profiles are suboptimal for transient miniburst traffic. This PR introduces a coordinated 'frugal-fusion' prefetch optimizer that synthesizes cross-tenant heat signals, a small ruleset language for safe warmup decisions, and a telemetry bridge that exports anonymized cost/latency signals to the econ services. Goals: reduce token-unit cost by shifting warmups to low-cost windows, avoid over-warming, and dynamically select quantization profiles for warm batches without exposing tenant data. This change is additive and behind the feature flag 'frugal_fusion_v1'. Summary of changes: 1) new service module prefetch/fusion orchestrator that aggregates prefills and emits safe warmup plans, 2) lightweight rules DSL and policy engine for warmup gating and budget limits, 3) quant-profile selector that recommends int8/int4 fallbacks tied to batch shape and perf guardrails, 4) telemetry bridge that pumps cost/latency histograms and policy decisions to the econ pipeline, 5) CLI tool redwoodctl prefetch simulate + dry-run export for operator validation, 6) unit and integration tests and a small perf benchmark harness. Backwards compatibility: config defaults preserve existing prefetch behavior unless the feature flag is enabled; migration notes below. Tests & performance: local simulations using synthetic traces (mixed chat/complete) show median per-token cost reduction of 12-16% for tenants with >15% cold-start traffic and average latency impact of +3ms tail in worst-case windows. Canary on small set of tenants (5 tenants) produced 14% cost saving and zero customer-facing errors over 72h. Safety: budget guardrails enforce a maximum warmup budget per tenant per hour and allow automatic rollback on SLO degradation. Telemetry is anonymized and sampled to avoid PII leakage; KMS encryption used for bridge credentials. Rollout plan: canary (feature flag + 5 tenants) -> expand to 20% traffic over 1 week -> full roll when metrics stable for 7 days. Operators can revert by disabling frugal_fusion_v1. Related work: builds on ENG-1211 (prefill telemetry schema), reuses parts of the batch-cache coordinator. Linear tickets: ENG-4321 (prefetch optimizer) and ENG-4333 (quant profile selector). Checklist: [x] design doc linked, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] perf harness, [x] e2e canary, [x] docs/console UI for toggling flag, [x] RBAC for telemetry bridge. Migration: default remains unchanged; to adopt, set tenant_policy.prefetch.strategy = "frugal_fusion": run redwoodctl prefetch simulate --tenant <id> and review dry-run report; optionally enable frugal_fusion_v1. Observability: new dashboards: Prefetch/Fusion Plans, Prefetch/Policy Matches, FrugalFusion-Cost-Delta; alerts: FFusion:BudgetExceeded, FFusion:SLORegression. Implementation notes: the fusion orchestrator keeps a compact sliding window (max 1h) of tenant sampling signatures and uses a bloom-filter-backed coalescer to propose shared warmups; quant selector samples batch shapes and consults an offline oracle for quality prediction before recommending lower precision. Runtime path changes are guarded and asynchronous to avoid blocking the main serving pipeline.

review_comments: Diego Morales: The bloom coalescer looks promising but we should bound memory. Please add an eviction strategy and a max-cardinality test.
Ava Chen: Added eviction and a max-card test; adjusted sliding window cardinality to 10k per shard (configurable).
Priya Patel: Quant selector needs a guard to avoid switching profiles mid-request; ensure recommendations only apply to new batches.
Ava Chen: Quant changes now apply only at batch-creation time; added docstring and an integration test to verify no mid-request mutation.
Ethan Walker: CI flake observed in perf harness; can you stabilize the synthetic trace seed?
Ava Chen: Fixed seeds and improved harness warmup; reran canary reports.
Security review (Sofia Martinez): Telemetry payload looks OK but add sampling and retention policy to telemetry/bridge/README.md
Ava Chen: Added sampling description and default retention of 7 days; bridge uses KMS for creds as noted.
ci_checks: unit-tests: pass (98% coverage on new modules)
release_notes: Add a configurable frugal-fusion prefetch optimizer that reduces cold-start-driven token costs by dynamically coordinating warmups and recommending quantization profiles; disabled by default and gated by frugal_fusion_v1 feature flag.
notes_for_ops: Enable via feature flag and validate with redwoodctl prefetch simulate dry-run output. Monitor Prefetch/Fusion Plans and FrugalFusion-Cost-Delta dashboards; watch FFusion:BudgetExceeded and FFusion:SLORegression alerts. Rollback by disabling frugal_fusion_v1.
